title: Ghost You Forever
description:
The job market is a bit of a dumpster fire right now. Job seekers, I understand how frustrating it has been!

Like the career bestie I am, I want to make it easier to navigate this job market. Sometimes the only way to do that is just to call out the nonsense with a bit of humor!

For more career tips, follow me: @kirchnercareers

Don’t forget to subscribe for weekly career advice, resume hacks, and job search strategy!

transcript: Could you tell me a little bit more about the next steps in the hiring process? Sure, I'd be happy to tell you a little bit more about the next steps. So, it usually takes us anywhere from 4 to 8 weeks to decide what we're going to do after this round of interviews. And then for the candidates we move forward, there'll be five more panel interviews with six to seven people. And then you will get to do a final vibe check with our CEO. And we're probably going to ask you to do some free work in there, but pass it off as a project assessment. And if you don't make it through any of those steps, I will ghost you forever and you will never hear from me again.
